comment: Documented (jsntrs-qr9): this is R11's third bullet verbatim -- "an out-of-range index (`a[0][]` on {\"a\":[]}) is nothing" -- and the case that separates R11 from R12. `a` matched the empty array, so `a[]` alone is `[]` (R12, a value was selected); the `[0]` then selects nothing, and S2 makes that nothing regardless of the flag.
